summary: Luxury, minimal, cinematic home page visual redesign emphasizing glassmorphism navigation and feature cards, refined hero imagery/typography, and consistent dark navy/charcoal backgrounds.
architectural_notes: Home page visual direction: minimal, premium, cinematic, modern luxury/editorial; not colorful, not template-like, not busy.
Hero image guidance: premium placeholder allowed (to be replaced later); must be sharp, lightly graded, not overly darkened/filtered.
Nav scroll behavior: transparent at top; on scroll increase blur/opacity and add very subtle deep navy/charcoal tint while remaining glassy.
Features cards section background: solid deep navy/charcoal (no background image) to emphasize glass card depth.
imageRequirements:
## Edit Images
- Generate a sharper, luxury editorial equestrian close-up (warm brown leather saddle/bridle detail, shallow depth of field, natural lighting; not overly dark or filtered) (hero-equestrian.dim_1600x900.png > hero-equestrian-editorial.dim_1600x900.png)

existing_features.title: Update the global navigation header to be fully transparent with a premium glassmorphism effect at the top of the page: backdrop blur 10–15px, very subtle white tint (rgba(255,255,255,0.08)), thin soft border (rgba(255,255,255,0.1)), and white navigation text. Remove the current solid/dark filled header background.

Implement scroll-based header styling: when the page is scrolled, slightly increase blur and opacity and add a very subtle darker tint (deep navy/charcoal at low opacity) while keeping the header glassy (not a solid bar).
Increase the header logo size to approximately 1.5× the current size while keeping alignment clean across breakpoints and ensuring it does not overlap navigation or push layout awkwardly.

Refine the Home page hero section to match a cinematic-but-clean luxury editorial style: use a sharp, high-resolution equestrian placeholder image (close-up leather saddle/bridle detail, warm brown tones, shallow depth of field, natural lighting), remove heavy/dark overlays, and apply only a very subtle top gradient for text readability while keeping the image crisp and visible.

Update hero typography and CTA button styling to match the requested direction: large elegant serif headline in white/soft warm white with a slight text shadow; generous spacing; primary button in warm gold; secondary button transparent with a white border; both buttons have a subtle hover lift animation (2–4px) with smooth transitions (avoid heavy scaling).

Restyle the Home page features/highlights cards as floating glass panels over a deep navy/charcoal section background: card background rgba(255,255,255,0.08), backdrop blur, thin soft border, subtle shadow, rounded corners, and a smooth hover lift of 2–4px. Remove/avoid heavy beige/grey blocks and avoid switching to ivory or light sections for this features area.

Enforce Home page section background consistency and spacing: reduce/replace alternating light backgrounds so the page uses mostly deep dark navy/charcoal with restrained transparent overlays; avoid white-heavy sections and flat grey sections; increase vertical spacing/breathing room between sections and slightly increase heading sizes where needed to maintain an editorial premium feel.

new_feature_requests.summary: Redesign navigation bar: fully transparent glassmorphism (blur 10–15px, subtle white tint/border), white text, larger logo (~1.5x), floating premium feel; on scroll increase blur/opacity and add subtle dark navy/charcoal tint while staying glassy

Update hero section: use sharp high-res cinematic equestrian placeholder image (saddle/bridle detail, warm browns, shallow DOF, natural light), remove heavy overlay, add only subtle top gradient; elegant large serif headline in soft white with slight shadow; generous spacing; primary warm gold button + secondary transparent with white border; subtle hover lift transitions

Restyle features section cards with glassmorphism: rgba(255,255,255,0.08) background, backdrop blur, thin soft border, subtle shadow, rounded corners, smooth hover lift (2–4px); avoid heavy beige/grey blocks; cards appear like floating glass panels

Enforce section background consistency: mostly deep dark navy/charcoal with transparent overlays; avoid alternating many colors, white-heavy sections, and flat greys; maintain restrained luxury aesthetic
Typography & spacing refinement: increase vertical spacing/breathing room between sections, slightly larger headings, clean elegant typography, avoid overcrowding for editorial premium look

projectName: Apply luxury glassmorphism navigation + cinematic hero + dark section consistency on Home page
